items.title: Make service startup rollback and shutdown drain transactional
acceptance: Startup failure at every acquisition point disposes all prior resources in reverse order.
An exclusive account/contract runtime lock prevents a second mutation owner before intent admission starts.
Shutdown closes admission, cancels new work, drains coordinator/reconcile/history/outcomes/writers, closes stores, then releases the lock.
SIGINT, SIGTERM, fatal startup error, and fatal runtime error share one idempotent lifecycle path.
Health exposes starting, ready, draining, failed_startup, and failed_shutdown with actionable details.
items.stop_line: Do not use process.exit to hide leaked handles or close stores while active consumers can still write.

items.title: Make append and rewrite writers durable, recoverable, and health-visible
acceptance: One failed write does not poison the scheduling chain for all subsequent writes.
In-memory indexes change only after durable commit.
Authoritative state uses transactional SQLite; remaining exports use atomic replace and corruption quarantine.
Disk full, permission, rename, fsync, corrupt-tail, and restart fault tests are green.
Persistence backlog and failure state are visible and block new exposure when execution truth is uncertain.
items.stop_line: Do not skip corrupt records silently or treat a successful in-memory update as a successful commit.
items.implementation_note: Outcome persistence now reports SQLite integrity and feed backlog counters through the existing health surface; restart durability is covered by tests. Remaining fault-injection and export atomicity acceptance stays open.

items.title: Move market evidence persistence behind bounded backpressure
acceptance: A dedicated persistence worker acknowledges durable commit before provider evidence mutates VenueState.
Identity events are never dropped; quote/depth coalescing is deterministic, measured, and retains provenance.
High-water overflow visibly degrades new exposure while preserving user-order, position, trade, EXIT, and reconciliation processing.
Burst and soak tests above TS-R2-07 rates publish event-loop, queue, commit, HTTP, memory, and disk SLOs.
Shutdown drains the queue or leaves a durable resumable cursor.
items.stop_line: Do not solve event-loop blocking by weakening execution-state durability or silently dropping identity events.

items.title: Decompose coordinator and service into explicit state-machine modules
acceptance: IntentAdmission, ExecutionSaga, ProtectionSaga, ReconciliationService, OutcomeFeed, EvidenceIngestor, and LifecycleSupervisor have explicit ports and state contracts.
Domain modules do not perform filesystem, network, clock, or SQLite IO directly.
Coordinator and service become thin orchestration/composition layers without behavior loss.
Characterization, transition, property, and fault tests stay green after each incremental extraction.
Automated architecture checks reject cycles and forbidden adapter imports.
items.stop_line: No big-bang rewrite, generic microservice framework, or premature venue-neutral abstraction.

items.title: Version and test the paired gateway and profile protocol contract
acceptance: Health and profile manifest intersect on protocol revision, schemas, prompt versions, semver ranges, capabilities, outcome feed, and artifact hashes.
Critical capabilities include semantic revision and provider acceptance evidence, not an unversioned boolean.
Cross-repository CI tests immutable gateway/profile SHAs across supported and intentionally incompatible pairs.
Armed mutation fails closed with an explicit mismatch while read-only diagnostics remain available.
Release and rollback select a signed pair manifest rather than independently latest components.
items.stop_line: Do not treat tested gateway version as informational when semantic compatibility controls mutation safety.

items.title: Enforce main protection and production supply-chain gates
acceptance: Both repositories enforce main rulesets with PR, review, resolved conversations, required checks, and no force-push/deletion.
Break-glass is narrow, audited, time-bounded, and tested.
Workflows use least privilege, immutable action SHAs, deterministic installs, secret/dependency/SAST checks, and CODEOWNERS.
Release publishes SBOM, checksums, provenance/attestation, and an immutable paired artifact manifest.
Deployment cannot promote armed mode without a separate human gate and attached PRAC/shadow evidence.
items.stop_line: Repository privacy and a small maintainer set do not replace enforced controls.

items.title: Publish a configurable 0.5% daily-capture objective and progress contract
acceptance: Packet publishes configured objective rate, baseline equity, target dollars, realized progress, remaining objective, and whether the objective is reached.
The default rate is 0.5% and remains operator-configurable and versioned.
The objective is contextual evidence only and never becomes an entry trigger, direction, quantity formula, or promise of achievable profit.
Reset boundaries and realized-PnL attribution are explicit and replay-testable.
Shared fixtures pass against glitch-topstep-hermes-profile issue 102.
items.stop_line: Do not turn the objective into a quota or size positions from the remaining target gap.

items.title: Protect daily capture with tighten-only owned stops and a realized-PnL entry lock
acceptance: After the configured objective is reached, new exposure is durably locked for the session while reductions and flatten remain available.
Owned stop changes are tighten-only and preserve complete quantity coverage with provider-confirmed receipts.
Realized, unrealized, fees, pending exposure, and reset boundaries cannot be conflated when calculating the lock.
Crash and reconnect tests prove the lock and protection state survive restart without duplicate mutations.
The gateway never widens risk or forces an exit solely to hit the objective.
items.stop_line: Do not advertise profit protection until provider-confirmed stop coverage and a durable realized-PnL lock are proven.

items.title: Publish the current partial bar and prior completed one-minute bar explicitly
acceptance: Packet exposes separately identified current partial and prior completed one-minute bars with timestamps and provenance.
Partial-bar progress and feature adjustments are explicit and cannot masquerade as closed-candle evidence.
Missing, stale, duplicated, or contradictory bar identity is reported as data quality rather than fabricated zero values.
Contract fixtures cover minute rollover, gaps, partial-only responses, and out-of-order history results.
Shared fixtures pass against glitch-topstep-hermes-profile issue 103.
items.stop_line: Do not publish one ambiguous latest bar or make a completed candle a universal execution gate.

items.title: Add bounded entry ranges and delivery-time supersession semantics
acceptance: Intent contract supports a bounded entry range tied to exact packet, contract, scope generation, and expiry.
Gateway revalidates the latest authoritative price immediately before mutation.
Outside-range delivery rejects the executable intent with an attributable supersession result and permits one fresh comparison.
Favorable movement outside the range never becomes implicit permission or causes the old intent to be amended.
Idempotent retry and stale-packet tests prove no old intent can execute against a new snapshot.
items.stop_line: Do not widen an entry range after delivery or replay an old intent against a newer packet.

items.title: Make pause, resume, mode, and flatten controls durable and content-bound
acceptance: Pause, resume, mode change, and flatten directives carry unique identity, content hash, scope, issuer, timestamp, and durable status.
Duplicate delivery is idempotent while changed content under a reused identity fails closed.
Restart resumes pending control work without silently replaying completed mutations.
Flatten remains available during degraded cognition and cannot be confused with a new-exposure command.
Health reports pending, applying, completed, rejected, and failed control states truthfully.
items.stop_line: Do not acknowledge a control command before its durable state and native effect are attributable.

items.title: Publish immediate lifecycle facts and execution-fidelity diagnostics
acceptance: Intent admission, submission, provider acceptance/rejection, partial fill, protection confirmation, amendment, exit fill, and flat are published as immediate attributable facts.
Diagnostics separate decision latency, transport latency, slippage, fees, rejection, fill quality, and protection fidelity.
Immediate facts remain visible until the revisioned enriched outcome catches up.
Corrections preserve stable identity and do not create duplicate learning episodes.
Shared fixtures pass against glitch-topstep-hermes-profile issue 107.
items.stop_line: Do not turn transport, provider, or protection failures into directional trading lessons.

items.title: Build a rate-aware multi-instrument universe and market-data plane
acceptance: An operator allowlist resolves to exact active ProjectX contract IDs, native tick economics, a scope hash, and explicit rollover generation.
One market-hub supervisor owns per-contract subscriptions and restores every configured subscription exactly once after reconnect.
A centralized scheduler warms and repairs bars for 4 to 6 instruments with measured headroom under ProjectX rate limits.
Quotes, bars, flow, depth, data quality, and evidence are isolated by exact contract ID; DOM is optional and bounded to a shortlist.
Additional instruments remain observation-only until paired global cognition and portfolio admission are compatible.
items.stop_line: Do not clone the full single-contract service per instrument or auto-trade every contract returned by discovery.

items.title: Add account-wide portfolio admission and exact-contract execution
acceptance: One selected exact contract is admitted under an account-wide serialization lock with current identity, range, lease, tick, quantity, and scope validation.
Protected worst-case downside includes every position, working or pending entry, fees, slippage reserve, hard loss floor, and daily-capture lock.
Ownership, protection, reconciliation, receipts, outcomes, and orphan cleanup are scoped by account plus contract.
Inactive or rolled contracts reject new exposure while existing old-contract positions remain monitored and reducible to flat.
Initial capability permits one newly selected instrument per account cycle; simultaneous cross-instrument exposure requires a later explicit capability.
items.stop_line: Do not race independent single-contract coordinators for account capacity or compare raw contract counts across different tick economics.
